environment.description: Same Celery worker deployed behind Kong Gateway (3.4.x) with a custom request-validator plugin configured using a JSON Schema definition that enforces 'options' field type constraint via additionalProperties and explicit type declarations. The schema is loaded from a ConfigMap mounted at /etc/kong/schemas/conversion-job.json. The plugin operates in 'strict' mode with coercion disabled (config.coerce_body=false), meaning any request where the 'options' field is not exactly type 'object' (or absent) receives HTTP 400 before reaching the Flask app or Redis queue. Note: the schema does NOT validate nested values within options dict - only the top-level type of the options field itself.
